summary: Stuck vendor credit memo w/ early-payment discount not auto-applied, causing negative supplier balance and PO release block
description:
Issue summary:
A vendor (Summit Materials) submitted a credit memo dated 2026-03-08 that includes an early-payment discount line. The credit posted to the supplier account but did not get applied against the open PO invoice(s). As a result the supplier account shows a negative unapplied credit and procurement cannot release a new PO or process scheduled shipments until the outstanding balance is reconciled.

Impact:
- Procurement blocked from releasing PO #PO-122347 for weekly shipments (estimated $48k).
- Supplier account presents a negative unapplied credit, causing AP aging reports to show an ATP (amount to pay) of $0 despite invoices outstanding.
- Risk of supplier escalation/stop-ship if not resolved within the week.

Environment:
- Redwood production AP ledger in us-east region.
- AP workflow: Supplier credit memos are normally matched to invoices and POs by AP auto-apply rules.

Desired outcome:
- Apply the vendor credit (including early-payment discount) to the correct invoice/PO lines, restore positive expected payables, and confirm procurement can proceed with PO release.
steps_to_reproduce: AP user (accounts-payable@redwood.com) uploads credit memo PDF to supplier account in FinanceUI
System creates supplier credit transaction SVC-20260308-774 and posts to GL account 2105
Auto-apply engine attempts matching rules (PO number, invoice reference) and returns 'no match found' for this memo
Procurement attempts to release PO PO-122347 and receives a block: 'supplier account has unapplied credit / negative balance'
logs: Finance service log excerpt 2026-03-08T15:12:34Z: CREATE_CREDIT supplier=Summit Materials id=SVC-20260308-774 total= -1200.00 lines=2
Auto-apply service 2026-03-08T15:12:35Z: RULE_MATCH attempted on PO=PO-122347 -> no reference found (vendor_ref null)
GL posting 2026-03-08T15:12:36Z: posted to GL 2105 code=credit memo; status=posted; document_ref=SVC-20260308-774
AP reconcile job 2026-03-09T02:00:01Z: reconcile_cycle=nightly; unmatched_credits_count=1; credit_id=SVC-20260308-774
comments: 2026-03-11 09:14 - Lina Chen: Raised ticket after procurement escalation. Attached PDF and internal AP upload log. Requested AP and Payments SMEs to triage.

2026-03-11 10:02 - Mateo Ruiz: Initial triage - confirmed credit posted but auto-apply returned no match. Hypothesis: vendor_ref field blank on uploaded credit memo, or discount line type not recognized by matcher.

2026-03-11 11:27 - Priya Nair (Procurement): Confirmed PO number appears on vendor PDF footer but not on AP upload metadata. Procurement can request vendor to resend, but prefer internal re-link if safe.
2026-03-12 08:45 - Alex Morgan (Payments): Verified GL posting and bank status — no outward payment; credit reduced supplier balance only in ledger. Bank not involved yet.

2026-03-12 14:10 - Mateo Ruiz: Ran manual matching script to simulate auto-apply rules. Script matched 100% when provided PO number and discount-coded as 'line_discount' but failed when discount labelled as 'adjustment'.
investigation_notes: Manual-match test: providing explicit PO-122347 mapping applied the credit and cleared the blocking flag for procurement UI.
Root cause hypothesis: Vendor's credit memo uses non-standard line type for early-payment discount ('adjustment' instead of 'discount') which the auto-apply parser ignores for PO matching.
Secondary cause: During AP upload the OCR/metadata extraction dropped vendor_ref field due to low-contrast font; system created credit without invoice/PO links.
Risk check: Manual linking is low-risk if GL entries remain unchanged; ensure audit trail and retaining original credit document reference.
Related configs: auto-apply parser ruleset v3.4.1; discount line mapping table lacks 'adjustment' alias.
workaround: Manual apply the credit to invoice INV-20260305-881 and mark link to PO-122347 in the system. Procurement can then proceed with PO release. Document manual linkage with audit comment and e-mail vendor to standardize future credits.
next_steps: 1) AP to manually link credit SVC-20260308-774 to INV-20260305-881 and annotate audit comment (assigned to Mateo).
2) Engineering to update auto-apply parser to accept 'adjustment' as a discount alias (ticket to eng team; see linked PR draft).
3) Ops to add weak-OCR retry / manual review flag when vendor_ref OCR confidence < 0.75 (reduce similar future misses).
4) Finance to notify vendor (Summit Materials) template requirements for credit memos and request resubmission as standard if vendor agrees.
5) Close-loop check: schedule follow-up 2026-03-18 to confirm no further unmatched credits from same vendor.
resolution: In progress - manual link applied as temporary fix; engineering change queued. Awaiting merged PR and vendor confirmation before closure.
